title: PLATO Attestation-Centric Submission Profile
description: Submit one or more attestations referencing existing SpatialEntities by URI. This profile is for incremental scholarly contribution: attesting evidence about SpatialEntities that already exist in the system without redefining them. Each attestation must specify its 'about' field.

profile.description: Identifies this as an attestation-centric submission.

@id.description: URI of the gazetteer. In attestation-centric mode, this should typically reference an existing gazetteer.

creator.description: The people or organisations to cite as the dataset's authors (dcterms:creator), each with a web address such as an ORCID, a name, or both. Not the same as contributor, the gazetteer's owner.

@id.description: A persistent address for the person or organisation: an ORCID, a ROR.

licence.description: The web address of the dataset's licence (dcterms:license), such as https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Required once status is 'published'.

version.description: The gazetteer's version indicator (dcat:version): '2026-09', '1.4'. A place is cited as its IRI plus this version.

status.description: Publication status (plato:gazetteer_status). Once 'published', the gazetteer's attestations are append-only: never deleted or changed, only superseded or retracted by new ones.

isVersionOf.description: For a frozen snapshot: the living gazetteer it is a version of (dcat:isVersionOf).

previousVersion.description: For a frozen snapshot: the snapshot before it (dcat:previousVersion).

keywords.description: Words a catalogue can find the dataset by (dcat:keyword).

spatial.description: The area the dataset covers, as web addresses (dcterms:spatial): a Wikidata or GeoNames region.

temporal.description: The years the dataset covers (dcterms:temporal, a dcterms:PeriodOfTime).

landingPage.description: The web page where people find and download the dataset (dcat:landingPage).

uriSpace.description: The base from which the dataset's places, sources and other entities have their web addresses (void:uriSpace), e.g. https://w3id.org/whg-epns/. Choose one you control and will keep.

dataSets.description: The statistical tables the document's figures belong to.

relationTypes.description: Relation types the document declares for its own use, each with the PLATO type it narrows.

allOf.description: In attestation-centric mode, 'about' is required, identifying the existing SpatialEntity being attested, except on a meta-attestation (one with 'meta'), which is about its target attestation.

newSpatialEntities.description: Optional: new SpatialEntities that do not yet exist in the system. Use sparingly — only when no existing SpatialEntity matches. These follow the place-centric pattern (SpatialEntity with nested attestations) but are submitted alongside attestation-centric contributions.

allOf.description: At the top level nothing supplies the subject, so it must be given.
